chartTypeId.help: The control chart type: p (fraction of defective units per sample, sample size may vary), np (number of defective units at a constant sample size n), c (number of defects per unit at a constant inspection opportunity) or u (defects per unit at a varying inspection opportunity). It determines which columns and settings exist: the sample size column only for p and u, the constant sample size only for np.

defectsRef.help: The defectives or defects column (slot 'defects'), or null. Value: a column from `read().pickableColumns.defects`, or null.

sizeRef.help: The sample size column (slot 'size', used by p and u), or null. Value: a column from `read().pickableColumns.size`, or null.

constantN.help: The constant sample size n of the np chart, a whole number of at least 1; it enters the center line n · p̄ and σ = √(n · p̄ · (1 − p̄)). It exists only for the np chart; the screen and `instance.set` accept whole numbers from 1.

baselineCount.help: How many of the first usable points form the baseline (Phase I), a whole number of at least 1; center line and limits are computed from it, the rules then check all points. Empty means all points; if the number exceeds the point count, all points count as well. The screen and `instance.set` accept whole numbers from 1.

enabledRules.help: The checked rules, a list from 1 (one point beyond UCL or LCL), 2 (9 points in a row on the same side of the center line), 3 (6 points in a row rising or falling), 5 (2 of 3 points beyond 2σ, same side) and 6 (4 of 5 points beyond 1σ, same side). Only rule 1 is preselected. Rules 4, 7 and 8 do not exist for attribute charts: counted data often has equal neighbours, so rule 4 (alternating up and down) would be unreliable; 7 and 8 are not provided. Rules 5 and 6 are checked only when σ stays the same, so not for p and u with varying sample sizes (the limits differ per point there), and not when σ = 0; they are then silently skipped even if checked.

activeColumnSlots.help: The column roles that apply to the current chart type: `defects` (field `defectsRef`) always, `size` (field `sizeRef`) only for p and u.

activeParams.help: The settings that apply to the current chart type: `chartTypeId`, `baselineCount`, `enabledRules`, plus `constantN` for np only.

pickableColumns.help: Per slot the columns the column fields accept, each { key, name }; the key is instanceId|sheetId|columnId.

result.help: The computed result, each figure described individually under keys; null without the required columns or with fewer than 2 usable points.

points.help: One row per plotted point: { value, n, ucl, lcl, signal }; n is null for the c chart. read({ fields: ['points'] }) returns them in full.

toggleRule.help: Checks or unchecks a rule; `enabledRules` stays free of duplicates and ascending.

params.ruleId: The rule: 1, 2, 3, 5 or 6 (meaning under `enabledRules`). Any other value is an error.

lastN.help: How many of the last points the tile chart shows; 0 shows all. Key figures and the stability badge always count all points.

showChart.help: Shows or hides the tile chart; the key figures stay.

Result.chartType: The control chart type used: p, np, c or u.
Result.statistic: The plotted quantity: proportion (p chart), count (np and c chart) or rate (defects per unit, u chart).
Result.valid: The number of usable points. For np and c these are the numbers in the defects column (empty and non-numeric cells are dropped); for p and u the rows where the defect count and the sample size are numbers and the size is greater than 0. The Violations tile shows it as the total.
Result.cl: The center line, computed from the baseline: for p the fraction p̄ = sum of defects / sum of sizes, for np n · p̄, for c the mean c̄ of the counts, for u ū = sum of defects / sum of sizes. The CL (Center Line) tile shows it with four decimals.
Result.ucl: The upper control limit UCL = center line + 3σ, with σ = √(p̄ · (1 − p̄) / n) for p, √(n · p̄ · (1 − p̄)) for np, √c̄ for c and √(ū / n) for u. It applies to all points alike and is a number only then. If the limits vary per point (p and u with unequal sample sizes) it is empty, as are LCL and σ; the limits per point are given with the individual points. The UCL / LCL tile then shows, under the label UCL̄ / LCL̄, the mean of the per-point limits, not this empty value.
Result.lcl: The lower control limit LCL = center line − 3σ, floored at 0 because counted values are not negative; σ as for the upper limit. Empty when the limits vary per point.
Result.sigma: The spread σ used for the limits and for rules 5 and 6 (formula per chart type under the upper limit). Empty when the limits vary per point.
Result.variableLimits: True when the limits differ per point: this happens for p and u as soon as the sample sizes are not all equal. UCL, LCL and σ are then empty, and rules 5 and 6 are not checked.
Result.violations: The rule violations under the checked rules, once per point and rule, sorted by point. The point counts from 0 over the usable points, so without dropped rows and not over the worksheet rows. For rules 2, 3, 5 and 6 every point of the pattern is its own violation.
Result.signals: The points with at least one rule violation, each only once, sorted by point and counted like the violations (from 0, over the usable points). The Violations tile counts exactly these points, not the individual rule violations.

Violation.index: The violating point, counted from 0 over the usable points (after empty rows are dropped), not over the worksheet rows.
Violation.ruleId: The violated rule: 1, 2, 3, 5 or 6 (meaning under the checked rules).
